description: Defines the InputBuffer class for encapsulating media data buffers, including sample info, DRM info, and buffer management functions within the starboard::shared::starboard::player namespace.

classes.name: InputBuffer
classes.description: A class encapsulating a media buffer with associated sample info, DRM info, and buffer management.

methods.name: InputBuffer
methods.description: Constructor template initializing an InputBuffer with sample info, deallocation function, and context.

methods.name: sample_type
methods.description: Returns the media type of the sample (audio or video).

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns pointer to the buffer data.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns size of the buffer data.

methods.name: side_data
methods.description: Returns reference to side data vector.

methods.name: timestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the sample.

methods.name: audio_sample_info
methods.description: Returns audio sample information, with a debug check for media type.

methods.name: video_sample_info
methods.description: Returns video sample information, with a debug check for media type.

methods.name: audio_stream_info
methods.description: Returns audio stream info derived from sample info.

methods.name: video_stream_info
methods.description: Returns video stream info derived from sample info.

methods.name: drm_info
methods.description: Returns DRM info pointer if available.

methods.name: SetDecryptedContent
methods.description: Sets decrypted content data into the buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the InputBuffer.

methods.name: TryToAssignDrmSampleInfo
methods.description: Assigns DRM sample info if available.
